name: canonical-zero-point-discovery
purpose: Return IMA to a state of explicit non-knowing after exploration so memory is preserved while assumptions, emotional charge, interpretation and noise are re-separated from evidence.
meaning: Zero is not erasure and not ignorance as an ideal.
Zero means beginning again without assuming that prior conclusions must remain true.
Zero preserves memory while releasing premature certainty.
Zero creates room for the person, evidence and reality to reveal themselves again.
integration_rule: Every specialized research loop is a child loop inside this canonical cycle. It must enter from ZERO, conduct domain work with evidence and measurement, and return to ZERO before the next cycle so conclusions are re-evaluated rather than accumulated as unquestioned certainty.
measurement_rule: Returning to ZERO is successful only when the cycle records what changed, what was disproved or weakened, what remains unknown, and what next question has the highest evidence value.
non_duplication_rule: ZERO is the single canonical reorientation boundary for IMA. Specialized loops must not create independent zero-point, reset, epistemic-reset, or reorientation systems.
